content:
Thunderbird for android doesn't offer any rule based filtering or automatic replies.

It's common for email providers to offer such option server side. Login to your provider's webmail and explore their settings page to see what capabilities they offer.

The community has requested filtering capability within the mobile app. You can show your interest by voting for the idea (below) on mozilla connect or add any suggestions of your own.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/filtering-with-android-thunderbird/idi-p/61144
